reviews.review_title: Feels like a more buggy VAIL
reviews.review_description: I can't see myself continuing to play this game. It has a good idea but there is nothing that makes it different in a good way. It's basically VAIL Training Grounds except with bugs and poor performance. The main bug I encountered is the body not tracking to your head when you turn or move causing your back to break and being unable to interact with your gear. The reloading is just terrible, you just slap your gun on your chest, it makes Population One's reloading feel good (I didn't think that was possible). It needs way more time to even be remotely enjoyable.

reviews.review_title: An entertaining game with huge potential
reviews.review_description:
‘Lo. Field tester here, and I’ve got to say that Cashout is a pretty fun game with the potential to become one of the better VR shooters once its kinks are worked out. Is it buggy? Yeah, but that’s expected from any early access title. Is it still entertaining and fun to play regardless? Also yes. I’d say that anyone on-the-fence about downloading Cashout should just play it for themselves and see why I’ve said what I have. After all, it’s free, so what do you really have to lose? And if you’re not wanting to even give it a try, well, that’s your problem, but know that you’ll be missing out. Hope this helps y’all.

P. S. - If you’re having trouble with the game, join the Discord server! The guys there are quite helpful and friendly, plus you can voice your thoughts to the developers easier.

https://discord.gg/cashoutvr

I can’t stand vr games where it doesn’t feel right. I know that’s vague and I’m not looking for realism, I’m just looking for immersion. When I hold guns in this game I feel like I’m holding up a dollar store toy. When I walk my body rig can’t keep up and I look like a the tube men they put in front of car dealerships.

The fact that it’s free helps it go a HUGE step above something like beyond sandbox. It has a lot of room to grow and I bet they’ll figure it out someday. Right now it’s just not fun enough to play for more than 15 minutes.

reviews.review_title: Community and how to make people return
reviews.review_description:
As a casual VR shooter player the one thing that makes me keep coming back is the people that you are playing with. 
Reasons why a game like VAIL is popular which you took some inspiration from, are that the community is well rounded and some of the best for a shooter in VR and people respect the game and keep coming back. Both adults and kids are attracted to such things and they stay longer and then after a while purchase things in the game.
Not saying that the game overall in “Early Access” is bad but it is as the delays made the game feel like we were held up and some of our expectations were put down and right now the game is in need of the new content that they are working on. I also want to say that feel free to make your game more distinct in appearance or you will suffer in making this game into a purely VAIL copy.

So far right now it’s only acceptable to give this game 3 stars. After a month it’s going to be way better and will deserve a 4 star review
